summary: Clear timed waves while fighting under the Test of Efficiency debuff.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Expect the trial debuff to be maintained throughout the encounter.
Use resources carefully and finish the active enemies before later waves arrive.
Complete the wave sequence within the fifteen-minute trial.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
